text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.04.02-rc2 completed. Smoke suite: warmup-heartbeat and prefix-prefill. Observed 7/120 failing probes (5.8%) — prefix-prefill 429s and warmup 503s concentrated on eu-w1-prefill-01..03.

ana: saw the 429 spike on dashboard, prefill queue depth jumped.

synth-watchdog: failing hosts: eu-w1-prefill-01, eu-w1-prefill-02, eu-w1-prefill-03. Error: "prefill-throttle" and "kv warmup timeout".

leo: do we want a quick pin of those hosts to previous runtime or reduce canary? change window is 30m.

oncall: recommend pin hosts first to limit customer impact. command: `deploy-bot pin-hosts --hosts eu-w1-prefill-01,02,03 --model rwd-t5-stable --reason "postdeploy prefill failures"`

ana: +1 pin. also add temporary prefills to stable route during triage.

deploy-bot: Pin accepted. Routing prefills to stable. Recheck scheduled in 2m.

synth-watchdog: recheck: failing probes reduced to 0/120. p95 back to baseline.

leo: opening ticket RW-1501 for autoscaler tuning and prefills stress test. will run a focused soak.

oncall: monitoring for 60m and will page if prefills >1% 429 for 5m.

ana: updating release notes: "Canary paused for prefill-heavy requests on subset of hosts; hosts pinned to stable runtime; investigation ongoing."
